data.one_liner: Collection of over 50 customizable animated icons powered by Rive.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use Rive animated icons with properties for color, stroke width, loop control, and tap/hover callbacks. It includes built-in accessibility support and simplifies working with Rive animations as interactive icon widgets.
use_when: You want to use animated icons built with Rive in your Flutter app.
You need interactive icons that respond to tap and hover states with motion.
avoid_when: You prefer standard static Material icons or simpler implicit widget animations.
You want a different animation engine like Lottie.
strengths: Over 50 pre-built animated icons available out of the box.
Supports custom colors, stroke widths, loop toggles, and interactivity callbacks like onTap and onHover.
weaknesses: Relies on the Rive ecosystem which adds its own native dependency footprint.
Limited to the predefined icon set provided by the package.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency to pubspec.yaml; uses the underlying Rive package which handles native setups.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using vector animations from Lottie instead of Rive.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to animate standard widgets and icons programmatically using extension methods instead of asset files.

data.minimal_example:
RiveAnimatedIcon(
    riveIcon: RiveIcon.home,
    width: 50,
    height: 50,
    color: Colors.green,
    strokeWidth: 3,
    loopAnimation: false,
    onTap: (){},
    onHover: (value){}
)
